impetusrift.configuration.title: Impetus Rife Configuration
research.impetusrift.base_impetuology.st:
There are two kinds of Impetus.
Ordinary Impetus is what seeps out of a rift. Devices can draw it from nearby, and touching it does no harm.
Shifting Impetus is ordinary Impetus after processing. It's stronger, travels farther, and forms a visible beam — the more energy it carries, the brighter the beam. It has to be routed through connections between nodes; it can't be drawn straight from a nearby rift the way ordinary Impetus can.
Any block connected to a beam is called an Impetus Node (nothing to do with aura nodes). Every node has input and output slots: producers have outputs only, carriers have both, and consumers have inputs only.

How to use the Linker:
· Hold the Linker and sneak-right-click a node to select it (blue highlight). Sneak-right-click the same node again to deselect.
· Once selected, right-click another node to link them (the first one outputs, the second one inputs). Right-click the second one again to remove the link.
· To send energy to several nodes: select the source, then right-click each target in turn. Mind the slot limits.
Connection limits: beams reach at most 8 blocks and can't pass through opaque blocks; glass and other transparent blocks let them through. When a node is selected, nodes feeding it show a red frame, nodes it feeds show green, and nodes doing both show purple. If you can't tell, just follow the direction of the beam.
Common nodes:
· Impetus Drainer: place it next to a flux rift. It converts ordinary Impetus into Shifting Impetus and outputs it. Smaller rifts yield less, and draining makes the rift shrink and destabilise, so keep an eye on it. A redstone signal shuts it down.
· Impetus Relay: 2 in, 2 out. It only relays beams and extends their reach.
· Impetus Diffuser: absorbs Shifting Impetus and diffuses ordinary Impetus outward, charging devices that would otherwise run off a rift (a gauntlet with an Impetus Cell, a Void Siphon, and so on). Never let it feed a Drainer — that creates an endless loop.
Impetus is a kind of energy drawn out of flux rifts. Until now I could only use a Void Siphon to condense it into Void Seeds, or keep a little in a gauntlet's cell — not much more than that. I want to automate the whole process.
The first step is the Impetus Gem. It doesn't generate energy by itself; it only receives and passes Impetus along. So I first need a source — a way to pull Impetus out of a flux rift. A Void Siphon can do that, but it needs a nether star, which is far too expensive. I'm going to build a device based on the same principle that doesn't need one.
There's still plenty of work ahead, but compared with the problems that stalled me before, the remaining steps are clear enough.

Now I can really start using Impetus.
I reworked the Void Siphon's design and built several new devices that gather, transfer, and distribute Impetus automatically. Impetuology is a bit convoluted — the best way to understand it is to set up a simple system and run it yourself.
The sections below explain how the whole thing works.
